prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi-statue demi statue portrait, five-material body (asymmetric), every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in ko-gyaru makeup — deeply sun-tanned bronze makeup over real skin, bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long bleached blonde hair with sun-streaked highlights, a bright cheeky grin. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a huge thick gold hoop hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest, a cinched waist above a big soft rounded belly and enormous round hips, her left arm crystal, her right arm carved stone, her torso a glass vessel, her thigh-stubs vessel and wood.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent deep blue sapphire crystal, one continuous carved mass, never hollow. Light passes straight through it. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid deep grey labradorite that flashes blue-green light, completely opaque, completely opaque. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (chest, belly, hips): a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled completely to the brim with clear clear emerald-green water with drifting water lilies, no hollow space, no air gap. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through it, rising to the collarbone line itself.

Left thigh (hip to tip): a small sculpted vessel of clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled with clear periwinkle-blue water with drifting feathers. A little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her left thigh curves inward and seals shut into its own small, smooth, rounded, closed tip — the vessel simply reaching its natural end there. Right thigh (hip to tip): carved from ONE solid block of striking orange-red padauk wood, completely opaque, completely opaque. A little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her right thigh curves inward and rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip — the wood simply reaching its natural end there.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm golden amber on one side and a deep charcoal grey on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so amber light glances off one side and grey light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
